_comment: Settings of the running experiment (owner's choices, 12-13 Nov 2026). OBJECTIVE: be profitable, +10%. Validated strategies only, sized by tested robustness (165 to 500 EUR), tested win rate of at least 55%; gains taken at +0.5% after costs and stop moved to a no-loss level after a 0.5% favourable move. Fast unvalidated trades were stopped for good on 13 Nov 19:40 Paris at the owner's request after 100+ live trades lost money to costs. The agent-consensus method only counts agents whose remembered signals made money. Simulated leverage allowed up to 3x. Research every 6 hours.
